name: Diamantslijperij Asscher
description: The Asscher diamond-cutting works on the Tolstraat, designed by the architect Gerrit van Arkel and finished in 1907: a long yellow-brick factory with huge windows to give the polishers light, and a castle-like front with corner turrets, the 1907 tablet and the name ASSCHER under a crown. At one time more than 500 diamond polishers worked here. Since 2017 the factory has held flats, while the tower is still the head office of Royal Asscher.
funFact: The Cullinan, the largest diamond ever found, was cut here; the streets of the surrounding Diamantbuurt are named after gems, such as Diamantstraat, Smaragdstraat and Saffierstraat.
